|lore=C-3PO was Jabba’s “khan chita,” or translator. Survived more battles than most members of the Alliance. Wasn’t informed of R2-D2’s role in the rescue of Han.
|game_text=When at a Jabba’s Palace site with R2-D2, once per turn may place your hand in Used Pile to draw the same number of cards from top of Reserve Deck. You must use 3 Force to play How Did We Get Into This Mess?. Game text canceled if Jabba on table.
|printings={{Card versions/See-Threepio}}
|notes=The surviving sheets both condition the two actions on the absence of Jabba, preserving the 3 Force cost and once-per-turn exchange. The later text phrases this as an express condition.
